visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a dark green t-shirt, stands in the center of the frame holding a black microphone with a white-striped cable. He is indoors in what appears to be a bedroom; a white bed with a black and brown cat lying on it is visible to the left, and a circular mirror hangs on the wall to the right. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from a window behind the man. (2) As the man sings, his facial expressions change dynamically, showing emotional intensity through furrowed brows and squinted eyes. He uses his free hand to gesture towards his chest or outward, emphasizing the lyrics. The camera remains static at an eye-level medium shot throughout the performance. (3) The background remains consistent with neutral-toned walls, a white-framed window with thin curtains, and various small items visible on a dresser below the mirror. The man maintains a focused, expressive gaze, occasionally looking slightly off-camera or closing his eyes to convey the mood of the song. (4) Towards the end of the video, he lowers the microphone slightly and relaxes his facial muscles, concluding the performance with a soft, final expression while looking directly into the lens.
